notes.title: Golf Peaks v3.60 (Nov 16th 2024) - main menu update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

This maintenance update for Golf Peaks is mostly aimed at improving the main menu which felt like it needed some love after all these years.

We've fixed the layouting for non-16:9 aspect ratios so that things are kept nice and center instead of weirdly stretching out for widescreen displays:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/653216cd2f9131e9f9f93af1c3c603a7e483e055.png[/img]

That nice key artwork we [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/923260/view/3793780512863894973]unveiled last year during Golf Peaks' 5th birthday celebration[/url] also looked a bit flat in the main menu so we reformatted the way it appears to make the main menu pop a bit more.

[h3]Patch notes for Golf Peaks v3.60:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved main menu layout for aspect ratios other than 16:9,
[*] Improved main menu artwork display,
[*] Added a new section to the main menu with info about our other games,
[/list]

Hope you keep enjoying Golf Peaks for years to come :)

Cheers,
Team at Afterburn

notes.title: Golf Peaks Scores 500+ Positive Reviews
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've hit a milestone with [b]Golf Peaks[/b] – over 500 overwhelmingly positive reviews on Steam! A huge thanks to everyone who took a swing at our puzzles and shared their thoughts. It means a lot to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/d757c05561b624e27ac4054564612c54c8e1df57.png[/img]

Seeing you all tackle the courses and enjoy the game is like watching a perfectly planned shot land. If you haven't had the chance to play yet, consider this your invitation to the tee.

Thanks for all the feedback and support. Here’s to continuing the journey together!

With appreciation,
Afterburn

notes.title: Golf Peaks v3.50 (Nov 13th 2023) - 5th Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[h3][u]5th birthday[/u][/h3]
Golf Peaks launched 5 years ago! We can hardly believe that it's been so long since we released our tiny golf puzzle game, which kickstarted our journey into crafting cozy puzzle games for everyone to enjoy. To celebrate this milestone, we've prepared a large maintenance update for Golf Peaks and discounts on all of our games!

[h3][u]Check out the new key art![/u][/h3]
The 5th anniversary of Golf Peaks sounded like the perfect opportunity to update the game's store visuals. To that end we've collaborated with an amazing Polish comic book artist - [b]Tomasz Spell[/b] (https://kreskotok.blogspot.com/) - to create this brand-new illustration:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/c4fc5a977c5d61f1c81a1a06fcd4bc5b2cda69e3.jpg[/img]
You can click on the image above and download it as a 4K wallpaper if you'd like!

[h3]Golf Peaks - v3.50 - patch notes[/h3]

[b]Golf Peaks is now Deck Verified. [/b]
[list][*] As part of this process we’ve improved gamepad controls, added display settings in the game & more![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/383c172e637099c0f180afa9134bd96748786b25.png[/img]

[b]Improved Options menu[/b]
[list][*] On PC/MacOS we’ve added display settings directly into the game to make it easier to change resolution & window settings,
[*] Settings that cycle through a list of options (like Language) now has arrows to allow navigation in two directions, making it easier to find what you’re looking for,[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/157a231c02255d8c154a4b6b4a917c91c24dcedf.gif[/img]
[list][*] We’ve also added a Mute Audio button & a whole new Accessibility section![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/ddb913b991c4fc2516db5e5f5d8b82653ea1dc13.gif[/img]]

[b]Added Accessibility options[/b]
[list][*] Reduced Motion Effects replaces camera transitions in the game with fades to make the game more pleasant for players prone to motion sickness,[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/cbaebeec20f14c87a0d987ea765eb78946cbf575.gif[/img]
[list][*] Unlock All Levels makes a comeback from Railbound, allowing you to immediately jump into any level in the game without having to complete prior ones,[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33476480/b76093316fb2c2a8f630672d7f856e1fe9f21bf8.gif[/img]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list][*] Added new key art to the main menu,
[*] Added a warning to the Clear Save panel,
[*] Updated Unity engine from version 2018 to 2021,
[*] Cleaned up old APIs to make the game more performant and lightweight,
[*] Inverted controls are now supported for keyboard & gamepad,
[*] Increased texture resolution for Afterburn logo in the intro scene,
[*] Added watermark with game version / build number in Main Menu,
[*] Fixed labels on certain buttons improperly wrapping text,
[*] Fixed label for “WORLD COMPLETE” message having an improper font weight,
[*] Added support for changing gamepads mid-gameplay,
[*] Added support for using scroll wheel in Credits,
[*] Added keyboard glyphs to several in-game buttons,
[*] Added keyboard prompts to game buttons,
[*] Added keyboard prompts to tutorials,
[*] Increased scroll wheel speed in Options,
[*] Fixed not being able to enter the hidden level when using Keyboard,
[*] Fixed grid layout for level buttons to avoid showing parts of buttons from the previous/next world,
[*] Fixed gameplay drag marker offset for non-16:9 displays,
[*] Updated Dutch localization,
[*] Updated in-game credits,
[*] Added keyboard shortcuts to main menu buttons,
[*] Updated Steamworks API,
[*] Improved cloud save synchronization between Windows, MacOS and Steam Deck,
[*]Improved Credits artwork layout for displays wider than 16:9,
[/list]

notes.title: Railbound - new puzzle game from Afterburn!
notes.content:
We can finally announce our new game - [b]Railbound[/b] - a comfy track-bending puzzle! 🚂🚃🚃🚃

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42290292/3bb53241a579149aaef23275dfa270d757d59edb.png[/img]

Connect and sever railways across the world to help everyone reach their homes, and solve over 100 clever puzzles ranging from gentle slopes to twisted passageways.

We’ve been working on the game since November and we’re gearing up to launch it in [b]mid-2022[/b] :)

For more info please visit [url=http://afterburn.games/railbound]http://afterburn.games/railbound[/url] or join our Discord server at [url=https://discord.gg/afterburn]https://discord.gg/afterburn[/url]
